policy: Huawei migrated from the legacy reccampportal/portal5 site to career.huawei.com/cn in August 2026. The legacy browser sources are disabled because they now resolve through a compatibility/redirect shell and can collapse to announcement HTML. Current graduate positions are collected by scripts/huawei_v2_official_harvester.py from the exact anonymous public getJobPage request emitted by the new Huawei Careers page.
